title: Galois field components of a finite group torsor
statement: Let K be a field [def-weil-field], G a finite group, and T a finite etale G-torsor over Spec K [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. There are a natural number r, fields E_i indexed by Fin r with K-algebra structures, and an isomorphism T.P -> coproduct_i Spec E_i over Spec K. Each E_i is finite dimensional over K [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], Galois, and its degree divides |G|. The isomorphism respects the actual structure morphism: its composite with the coproduct of the algebra-induced maps Spec E_i -> Spec K equals T.pi. No DVR, root algebra, normalization, or ramification conclusion is involved.

source.place: Tags 03SF and 03QR; the finite etale field/Galois-set correspondence and the torsor action

proof.text: Install the finite and etale instances of T.pi. Finiteness over the affine base makes T.P affine. Equip its global sections with T.pi.GammaAlgebra and use T.pi.etale_GammaAlgebra. Mathlib Algebra.Etale.iff_exists_algEquiv_prod decomposes this algebra into a finite product of finite separable fields L_i. Keep the index I in Type u when using sigmaSpec, whose IsIso instance has equal ring and index universes. Compose T.P.isoSpec, Spec of the inverse algebra equivalence, and the inverse sigmaSpec isomorphism. Prove the structure equation by checking on each coproduct inclusion, using the algebra equivalence commutes law and the Gamma-Spec triangle identity. Reindex I by Fin(Fintype.card I) with Sigma.reindex, proving the structure equation again using Sigma.iota_reindex_hom and Sigma.iota_desc.

For each factor E_i, use its finite-dimensional instance from the algebra decomposition. Compose its coproduct inclusion with the inverse of the assembled scheme isomorphism to obtain an open immersion j_i:Spec E_i -> T.P. The structure equation and Sigma.iota_desc prove j_i;T.pi=Spec(algebraMap K E_i). Apply field_torsor_component_galois_group [lem-sbc-field-torsor-component-galois-group] to obtain IsGalois K E_i and a subgroup H_i of G with Aut_K(E_i) isomorphic to H_i.

Rewrite finrank K E_i using Mathlib IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, then rewrite the automorphism cardinality with Nat.card_congr applied to the group equivalence. Mathlib Subgroup.card_subgroup_dvd_card gives the remaining divisibility. Package the fields, instances, the component properties, and the explicitly assembled isomorphism over Spec K. No arbitrary witness of an unproved existence theorem is used in a definition.

lean.statement:
theorem field_torsor_galois_components
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (T : GaloisCover G (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (E : Fin r → Type u) (hE : ∀ i, Field (E i))
      (aE : ∀ i, Algebra K (E i)),
      letI := hE
      letI := aE
      (∀ i, FiniteDimensional K (E i) ∧ IsGalois K (E i) ∧
        Module.finrank K (E i) ∣ Nat.card G) ∧
      ∃ e : T.P ≅ ∐ fun i : Fin r ↦ Spec (CommRingCat.of (E i)),
        e.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun i : Fin r ↦
          Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (E i)))) = T.π
